settings.content:
With our Pop On Veneers Color Samples, you’ll receive 3 discs of real Pop On Veneers material, one in each shade we offer:

  • Hollywood White – Brightest, boldest smile
  • Natural White – Most popular, balanced look
  • Mature Tan – Warm, natural tone

Each sample is made from the same material used in your final veneers, so you can see how your new smile will truly look.

Ships via USPS

Your color samples are shipped through USPS in a standard envelope, so you can start choosing your new smile right away.

Try It On at Home

Each color is attached with a removable glue dot so you can:

  • Lift the sample and hold it over your teeth
  • Compare each shade in different lighting
  • See what looks best on you before you commit

No guessing. No surprises.

Choose the Smile You Want

Pop On Veneers fully cover your natural teeth, so you don’t need to match your current shade.

Pick the color that gives you the confidence you’re looking for.

What’s Included

  • 1 tri-fold color sample brochure
  • 3 removable color discs (Hollywood White, Natural White, Mature Tan)
  • Quick guide to help you choose your perfect shade

settings.bottom_text: We’re All In! Prices include $99 non refundable plan fee (before taxes)
